backup.production_rule: Money consolidation (s143), server side. 20261210000000 adds the nullable column public.transactions.payment_method (check: gcash, bank, cash, card, other), six internal helper functions (granted to nobody), the function bill_reading_set_v1 (signed-in users, gated by bill_can_v1) and replaces ten bill/expense functions: bill_step_v1, bill_pay_open_v1, bill_due_open_v1, bill_entry_v1, bill_daily_v1, utility_bill_estimate_v1, today_bills_v1, bill_pay_settle_v1 (paid_on, method), expenses_screen_v1 and admin_save_transaction_v2 (payment_method). Every replaced function keeps all existing JSON keys and only gains keys. It stops (55000) if any of the ten is not the body it was cut from (md5 of prosrc). Category back-fill of old bill rows is NOT in the migration: docs/s143/laneS/backfill_category.sql runs separately with Lloyd's yes.
backup.notes: restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: restamp them with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs). The migration carries no begin/commit (the runner wraps it); the rollback carries its own and refuses (55000) once a ledger row carries a payment_method. source.commit is the base the lane started from; the lane commit is the branch tip. Apply the SQL before the Staff release. Rehearse with migration-rehearsal-on-host.sh and the pgTAP suite s143_money before the apply.

forward_verification.name: payment_method_column_and_check
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'transactions' and column_name = 'payment_method' and is_nullable = 'YES') and exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.transactions'::regclass and conname = 'transactions_payment_method_check')

forward_verification.name: ten_replaced_functions_have_the_new_bodies
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 10 and bool_and(md5(replace(p.prosrc, chr(13), '')) = v.m) from (values ('bill_step_v1', '44d8d6670985d060556cd772cc61b3c4'), ('bill_pay_open_v1', 'b090554ca873215100d9167579c0facc'), ('bill_due_open_v1', 'c5781b6c5b7c59e8621b17fef0a2d29a'), ('bill_entry_v1', 'b9445c74b9de12d095258176dbba99df'), ('bill_daily_v1', '1726ac329d265f98a9c345aae083d729'), ('utility_bill_estimate_v1', '615c5e6719f1d35872e885c6f5084587'), ('today_bills_v1', '563053ef8469130428e9d35f09cc7762'), ('bill_pay_settle_v1', '591176b334a7f6089a25b79ee2a4b245'), ('expenses_screen_v1', '87d5b34bc801736104bf69da5019b792'), ('admin_save_transaction_v2', '2eebbce5a512ddf389b6361ff85ae74d')) v(n, m) join pg_proc p on p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace and p.proname = v.n

forward_verification.name: bill_reading_set_is_for_signed_in_users_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.bill_reading_set_v1(uuid,text,date,numeric,boolean)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.bill_reading_set_v1(uuid,text,date,numeric,boolean)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.bill_reading_set_v1(uuid,text,date,numeric,boolean)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: six_helpers_are_granted_to_nobody
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from unnest(array['public.utility_add_months_v1(date,integer)', 'public.utility_meter_rows_v1(uuid,text,text)', 'public.utility_meter_cycle_v1(uuid,text,date,jsonb)', 'public.utility_cycle_php_v1(uuid,text,date,date,jsonb)', 'public.utility_bill_span_v1(uuid,text,uuid)', 'public.utility_last_bill_v1(uuid,text)']) f where has_function_privilege('anon', f, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('authenticated', f, 'execute') or has_function_privilege('service_role', f, 'execute'))

forward_verification.name: month_end_anchor_kept
forward_verification.query: select public.utility_add_months_v1(date '2027-01-31', 1) = date '2027-02-28' and public.utility_add_months_v1(date '2027-01-31', 2) = date '2027-03-31'

forward_verification.name: estimate_key_sets_unchanged
forward_verification.query: select (select array_agg(k order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(e -> 'electric') k) = array['billed_month','cycle_from','cycle_to','days','days_in_cycle','fixed_php','forecast_kwh','forecast_php','kwh','last_reading_at','overdue','per_day_kwh','per_day_php','rate','so_far_php'] and (select array_agg(k order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(e -> 'water') k) = array['billed_month','cycle_from','cycle_to','days','forecast_m3','forecast_php','m3','min_m3','min_php','next_php','next_upto','overdue','per_day_m3','so_far_php'] from (select public.utility_bill_estimate_v1(gen_random_uuid(), public.manila_today()) e) x

rollback.safe_until: until a ledger row carries a payment_method (the rollback refuses with 55000 rather than lose it)

steps.name: restore_previous_bodies_and_drop_additions
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261210_s143_money.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (puts the ten previous bodies back, drops bill_reading_set_v1, the six helpers and the payment_method column)

the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (a replaced function is not the body it was cut from)
the pgTAP suite s143_money has not passed on this commit
the superseded assertions in s131_meter_cycle.sql have not been updated
